NOW LIVE! / Black Friday
The official Amazon Black Friday sale is now live ! Today marks the beginning of its massive 12-day long Black Friday event leading right up to and beyond Thanksgiving and Black Friday with millions of price drops on just about everything. You’ll find loads of Apple deals from AirPods Pro 3 and the lowest prices ever on Apple Watch Series 12 , to rare deals on MacBook Neo from $649 . All of which join as much as $400 off Google Pixel and Samsung Galaxy gear , you’ll find thousands in savings on TVs, apparel from top brands, kitchen and home goods, gaming gear for your battlestation, the lowest prices ever on the brand new Amazon Android Alexa Tablets , and much more now on sale and up for grabs right here .
Official 2026 Amazon Black Friday Week sale now live
Amazon announced this year’s giant sale event last to reveal what effectively amounts to a 12 day sale that kicks off today before updating on November 28 and running through November 30 for its Cyber Monday event. While there will be an influx if discounts through the duration of the sale (12 days of daily themed deal drops at up to 60% off ), the main event kicks off right now and many of the best deals are now live.

When does Amazon’s Black Friday sale start?
Amazon’s Black Friday sale starts on November 19 and runs right through until Cyber Monday.
What time does Amazon Black Friday start?
Amazon’s Black Friday sale starts at 12:01 a.m. PT/3:01 a.m. ET on November 19.
Where do you find the best deals during Black Friday?
Amazon’s main Black Friday sale page does house thousands of price drops, but the best way to find deals is at 9to5Toys.com where we are scouring thousands of listings at Amazon for the very best deals. Many of the most notable offers aren’t even highlighted on Amazon’s main sale page, or are, at the very least, quite difficult to find amongst the clutter.
When does Amazon’s Black Friday sale end?
Amazon is advertising this year’s sale as a 12-day event that runs right through November 30 for Cyber Monday. However, the official Black Friday sale ends on Saturday, November 28 at 3:00 a.m. ET (typically early morning on the Saturday after Black Friday) before it immediately transitions into its Cyber Monday sale all weekend long.
Will there be better deals on Black Friday next week?
It is possible and there will be additional products added to the sale each day from now until then, but the big ticket items tend to drop when the sale begins, and will only see minor price drops in most cases as it progresses through. There are some outliers here, but the best deals are for the most part going live on November 19 and additional products will added as we move towards Thanksgiving and Black Friday 2026.
